13-1.title: Measuring retrieval
13-1.tldr: Use a labeled (query, relevant docs) set and ranked metrics — Recall@k, Precision@k, MRR, NDCG — and track zero-result rate.
points: Recall@k: did the relevant docs make the top-k?
Precision@k / MRR / NDCG: how high and how well-ordered the hits are.
Track zero-result rate and score distributions in production.

13-2.title: Chunk doesn't contain the answer
13-2.tldr: 'Looked relevant' isn't 'contains the answer': read the chunk and confirm the answer span is present; if not, retrieval failed; if yes, generation failed.
points: First check: is the answer actually in the retrieved chunk?
No → retrieval failure (chunking, index, query mismatch).

13-3.title: Context doesn't answer the question
13-3.tldr: Detect that the context is insufficient, then answer only from what's supported: gate on retrieval score/answerability, allow explicit 'I don't know', and verify claims against the context.

13-4.title: Conflicting / outdated documents
13-4.tldr: Apply precedence before generation — recency, source authority, or an explicit priority field; dedupe/reconcile; and surface the conflict (or abstain).
points: Precedence: newest / most authoritative / priority field.
Surface the conflict or abstain rather than guess.

13-5.title: No relevant documents
13-5.tldr: When retrieval returns nothing relevant, abstain rather than answer from noise: gate on a score threshold or answerability check and return 'not enough information'.
points: Gate on retrieval score or answerability.
Abstain or ask a clarifying question.

13-6.title: Different answers on different days
13-6.tldr: Run-to-run variation comes from sampling (temperature/seed), non-deterministic remote rerankers, and embedding drift (provider updates the model behind the same name, or you switch models).
points: Sampling: pin temperature 0 and use a seed.
Embedding drift: fingerprint the model and re-index on change.

13-7.title: Vocabulary mismatch
13-7.tldr: The doc says 'myocardial infarction', the user says 'heart attack': use semantic embeddings, query expansion/synonyms, HyDE, and hybrid search to bridge the wording gap.
points: HyDE: retrieve with a generated hypothetical answer.

13-8.title: Per-stage error handling
13-8.tldr: Isolate each stage so one failure degrades rather than aborts: retrieval returns empty/flagged, reranking falls back to pre-rerank order, generation surfaces a structured error.
points: Degrade, don't abort the whole pipeline.

13-9.title: Building a retrieval eval set
13-9.tldr: Bootstrap with real queries from logs, then label relevance with an LLM judge, RAGAS-style (a strong model's cited chunks as gold), or synthetic queries built from known documents.
points: Label via LLM judge or a strong model's citations.
Or synthesize queries from known documents (doc = gold).

13-10.title: Design a RAG system: tests failure-mode awareness
13-10.tldr: 'Design a RAG system' tests whether you know how it fails, not whether you can draw boxes.
points: Dense fallback only on empty, not on wrong.
score_threshold defaults none → weak chunks pass.
Metadata filters dropped at the retriever.

13-11.title: 'The model made something up': hallucination handling
13-11.tldr: 'The model made something up' is testing hallucination handling, not model quality.
